Transportation fee policy:

* The transportation fee has to be paid in advance for the term, and it is non-refundable.

* A student who avails the transportation facility even for a day is liable to pay transportation fees for the full term and no discount is permissible.

* Cancellation of the transport has to be done in the prescribed form from the registration office before the commencement of the following term.

* Minimum number of students are required to provide transport to a particular area.

* The Transportation fees may subject to change on the prevailing market condition.

* In case a student wishes to discontinue availing of school transport facility, he/she has to give a month’s prior notice to the Registration Office, failing which the next instalment of fee will be due and has to be paid. Verbal or electronic messaging communication to the teachers, drivers or transport in charges will not be accepted in this regard.

Particular First Term Second Term Third Term
Transportation Fee If the student leaves at any time during the term, the parent must pay the transport fee for the 1st term. If the student goes at any time during the term, the parent must pay inclusively full 1st and 2nd term transport fees. If the student leaves at any time during the term, the parent must pay the transport fee for all the three terms.
